Im not an admin or anything, but with this latest exodus I've noticed a lot of the same questions popping up as previous ones so figured some general info might be helpful. If I get anything wrong or forget anything I'm sure others who've been here a while will correct me.

As most know, when you first signup there are voting limits until you reach a certain number of comment "karma" (100 is when all voting restrictions are removed). Submissions don't count toward this cap, just comments. While slightly annoying at first, this is in place to prevent brigading.

If you want to moderate your own subverses, there is a limit of 10 subs that a single user can moderate. You can also block subverses that you're not interested in seeing.

While Voat is for the most part censorship free, there are some rules (ie nothing illegal, no doxxing, no threatening people). More info on that can be found here:

https://voat.co/help/useragreement

The admins have made it clear that these rules are applied consistently and no group or individual will be favored because of personal opinions. Admins are active users, listen to/respond to feedback and have seemed to make every attempt to be fair and transparent. They are @Atko and @Puttitout

General info about Voat can be found here:

https://voat.co/about

For more information you can also check out /v/announcements and /v/voatdev
Some info for all the new users

I'd also like to add that there are currently at least two okay apps for android:

  • Boats for Voat
  • Vulcan

Both are alright, but they are under active development and there's still a lot of thing to implement. e.g. You can't log into your Voat account on Vulcan. I have both installed right now and haven't made my mind yet as to which one I'll settle with.

For images, if possible at all, please use Veuwer instead of Imgur. Veuwer is an image hosting project made specifically for Voat, so please support it.
